title: Towing company advertising: channels and budgets

facts.fact: Adwave's towing-company advertising mix starts at $30 a day, with ads made from the company's website.
facts.quote: With Adwave, that mix starts at $30 a day, with ads made from your website.

facts.fact: Adwave lists TikTok as an opt-in channel from about $91 per day.
facts.quote: TikTok | Short video for younger local drivers | Opt-in, from about $91/day

facts.fact: Adwave daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription and no contract.
facts.quote: Adwave daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription and no contract.

facts.fact: At a $30 daily budget, Adwave's 30-day planning figure is $900.
facts.quote: | $30 | TV, Google (Search included), Facebook and Instagram, web and mobile | $900 |

facts.fact: At a $35 daily budget, Adwave's 30-day planning figure is $1,050 and the mix adds Reddit.
At a $75 daily budget (a pricing page planning example), Adwave's 30-day planning figure is $2,250.
facts.quote: | $75 (pricing page planning example) | Same mix with more room per channel | $2,250 |

facts.fact: At a $91 daily budget, Adwave's 30-day planning figure is $2,730 and TikTok becomes available as an opt-in.
facts.quote: | $91 | TikTok becomes available as an opt-in | $2,730 |

facts.fact: Extra creative production on Adwave costs $0.38 per image.
facts.quote: extra creation costs $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: Extra creative production on Adwave costs $6 per 15-second TV spot.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: Adwave's 30-day totals are planning figures, and advertisers can pause before 30 days and are charged only for what runs.
facts.quote: The 30-day totals are planning figures. You can pause before 30 days and you’re charged only for what runs.

facts.fact: Adwave charges processing fees on card deposits, while ACH deposits have no added fee.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout; ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: On Adwave, a new daily budget applies the same day if the wallet covers it, with no proration.
facts.quote: On a live campaign, a new daily budget applies the same day if your wallet covers it, with no proration.

facts.fact: Adwave's TikTok, Facebook, Instagram and Reddit ads run on connected accounts Adwave owns, and Adwave sets up a Google Ads account for the workspace.
facts.quote: You don’t open separate ad accounts: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reddit ads run on connected accounts Adwave owns, and Adwave sets up a Google Ads account for your workspace.

facts.fact: Adwave's Google Search threshold for towing companies is the $30/day minimum.
facts.quote: | Google Search | Reach drivers searching for a tow, roadside help or a flatbed nearby | From the $30/day minimum |

facts.fact: The FTC's Endorsement Guides, which the page says businesses should follow for reviews and testimonials, were revised in 2023.
facts.quote: points businesses to the Rule on the Use of Consumer Reviews and Testimonials and the Endorsement Guides, revised in 2023.
